lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines. Spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-section, becoming narrower toward the anterior shoulder region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the 9th line (counting from the anterior), which splits as it approaches the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 10th, 11th, and 12th posterior lines are discontinuous, terminating as abbreviated segments or clusters of spots before reaching the ventral mass.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A high-density cluster of approximately 8-10 white spots is localized on the lower posterior haunch, just above the hock.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A horizontal alignment of three distinct spots is visible on the mid-thigh, forming a semi-connected geometric line segment.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron-shaped marking between the eyes; secondary white patch on the lower throat; white bands present on the lower sections of all four limbs.
